sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We need a lightweight user test template.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I've used one at my last job.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Perfect, {S2|owner} adapts it for us by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay, {DATE_REL} is fine by me.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Do we have a template for quick user tests?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I can bring the one from my last job.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great, {S2|owner} shares an adapted version by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Fine, {DATE_REL} it is.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Engineering should agree to the spec freeze.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: So {S1|owner} raises it with {TEAM|owner} at their planning on {DATE_ABS|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Sorry, did you say {TEAM}?

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I'll talk to engineering about freezing specs.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: When?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay, {S1|owner} takes it to {TEAM|owner} at planning on {DATE_ABS|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Sorry, did you say {TEAM}?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The weekly interview slot needs to be in everyone's calendar.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S2|owner} sets up the recurring slot by {DATE_REL|deadline}.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Will do.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Let's get the weekly interview slot booked.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I'll send the invite.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thanks, {S2|owner} books it by {DATE_REL|deadline}.
